title: Left-resolution chain-complex maps send zero morphisms to zero
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $C$ be a category with zero morphisms, and let $\iota:C\to A$ be full and faithful. Let $\Lambda=(F,\pi)$ be a left resolution of $\iota$ [lem-sfb-left-resolution-reduced-api] (a functor $F:A\to C$ and a natural transformation $\pi:\iota F\Rightarrow\operatorname{id}_A$ with epimorphic components) whose functor $F$ preserves zero morphisms. For an object $X$ of $A$ let $\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplex}(X)$ be the $\mathbb N$-indexed chain complex in $C$ with terms $F(X)$ in degree $0$, $F(\ker\pi_X)$ in degree $1$ and $F(\ker\iota(d_{n+1,n}))$ in degree $n+2$, whose differentials $d$ are the unique maps with $\iota(d)$ equal to the component of $\pi$ at the kernel followed by the kernel inclusion; for $f:X\to Y$ let $\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplexMap}(f)$ be the chain map given by $F(f)$ in degree $0$ and by $F$ of the induced kernel maps in higher degrees. Then for all objects $X,Y$ of $A$, $\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplexMap}(0_{X,Y})=0_{\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplex}(X),\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplex}(Y)}$.

mathlib_searches.query: A left resolution preserving zero morphisms maps a zero morphism to the zero chain-complex morphism

from.place: The bounded-minus support argument uses the zero-morphism preservation of the objectwise left-resolution chain-complex functor.
